findings.title: Train/test split is by encounter, not patient
findings.evidence: 92.8% of test patients (1164/1254) also appear in training.
findings.reproduce: python audit/harness.py  (see overlap metric in findings.json)

findings.title: Imputer and scaler are fit before the split
findings.evidence: preprocess() output has zero mean over all rows, so test rows informed the fitted statistics. Max mean shift vs train-only fit: 0.0305.

findings.title: Reported AUROC is inflated relative to patient-disjoint evaluation
findings.evidence: Reported 0.736 vs patient-grouped 5-fold 0.696 (SD 0.016). Gap exceeds 2 SD of fold variance.
